2608.06122.title: Is Self-Pretraining really useful to improve diagnosis in medical Time Series?
2608.06122.paper_summary: Inspired by recent evidence that transformer architectures benefit from Self-PreTraining (SPT) on long-context benchmarks, we investigate whether similar gains extend to multimodal, multivariate, and even simple univariate medical time series. Our objective is to assess the impact of SPT on the performance and scalability of transformer-based models across diverse medical applications, particularly under limited data conditions. We evaluate transformer architectures on three representative medical time-series tasks: rehabilitation robotics (Camargo dataset), stress detection (Non-EEG Stress), and Parkinson's disease detection (Gait Parkinson's Disease). Models are trained either from scratch or through SPT using four masking-based objectives designed to promote temporal and cross-modal representation learning, and we systematically vary model depth to examine how capacity interacts with pre-training benefits. Across datasets and configurations, SPT consistently improves classification accuracy by 0-6 percentage points depending on masking strategy, dataset and architecture, with gains observed not only in multivariate settings but also when models are restricted to simple univariate inputs. The improvements increase for deeper models that can better exploit the enriched temporal representations learned during pre-training. These findings indicate that SPT is a simple and general strategy that enhances transformer performance on medical time-series tasks without requiring task-specific architectural changes, supporting its potential to improve robustness and accuracy in data-limited clinical settings.
2608.06122.paper_summary_zh: 受到最近證據的啟發，顯示Transformer架構在長上下文基準上受益於自我預訓練（SPT），我們調查類似的增益是否擴展到多模態、多變量，甚至簡單的單變量醫療時間序列。我們的目標是評估SPT對基於Transformer的模型在各種醫療應用中的性能和可擴展性的影響，特別是在數據有限的條件下。我們在三個具有代表性的醫療時間序列任務上評估Transformer架構：康復機器人（Camargo數據集）、壓力檢測（非EEG壓力）和帕金森病檢測（步態帕金森病）。模型要麼從頭開始訓練，要麼通過SPT使用四個基於遮罩的目標進行訓練，這些目標旨在促進時間和跨模態表示學習，我們系統地改變模型深度，以檢查容量如何與預訓練的好處互動。在數據集和配置中，根據遮罩策略、數據集和架構，SPT始終提高分類準確率0-6個百分點，增益不僅在多變量設置中觀察到，當模型限制為簡單的單變量輸入時也有觀察到。對於更深的模型，這些改進增加了，因為它們能更好地利用在預訓練期間學到的豐富時間表示。這些發現表明，SPT是一種簡單且通用的策略，能增強Transformer在醫療時間序列任務上的性能，而無需特定任務的架構變更，支持其在數據有限的臨床環境中提高穩健性和準確性的潛力。
